description: This Python source file defines a configuration class `AmazonQwen3Config` for transforming requests and responses between OpenAI-compatible formats and Amazon Bedrock's Qwen3 model API. It includes methods for parameter mapping, request transformation, message formatting, and response processing specific to the `qwen3` model within the `litellm` project.

classes.name: AmazonQwen3Config
classes.description: Configuration class for sending `qwen3` requests to Amazon Bedrock's `/bedrock/invoke/` endpoint. It manages request parameter mappings, message formatting for prompts, and response transformation from Qwen3 output back to OpenAI-like responses.

methods.description: Initializes the configuration with optional parameters for max tokens, temperature, top_p, top_k, and stop tokens.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by this model configuration.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters into the optional_params dictionary suitable for Qwen3 requests, handling each known parameter.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI format request into the specific Qwen3 Bedrock invoke request format, converting message content into a prompt string and including optional parameters.

methods.name: str _convert_messages_to_prompt(self, messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Converts a list of OpenAI message objects into a Qwen3 prompt string with support for system, user, assistant, and tool message types, including multimodal content handling.
